title: Automatic Billing
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM

Automatic Billing

Use

Automatic billing enables you to bill a single contract or any selection of contracts. Contracts not allocated to an installation are

not selected. Billing is executed based on intervals defined in scheduling. All master data that form the basis of the contract — such
as the installation, device or register — are automatically taken into account.

Integration

Automatic billing provides a link between general master data and invoicing. In addition to general master data, the following
billing master data are included in automatic billing:

e Rate Type

e Operand

e Price

e Price Adjustment Clause
e Rate

e Schema

e Rate Category

e Rate Determination

e Variants

e Discounts

e Franchise Fees

Scheduling determines how often billing runs occur. All billed contracts of a contract account can be invoiced, which is followed by
printing of the bill.

Prerequisites

All master data and billing master data must be consistent before billing can be executed.
This means the following:

e Abusiness partner and a contract must be allocated to the installation in move-in processing.
e Devices containing registers must be allocated to this installation in device installation.
e Meter reading orders must be generated and meter reading results must be entered in meter reading.

e The schedule records must be created in scheduling.
